known.article: Paso Robles Willow Creek District AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "Paso Robles Willow Creek District AVA"

climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A mountainous district inside the Paso Robles AVA, west of Highway 101 and bordering the Santa Lucia Range. It has a strong marine influence, a cool Winkler Region II growing season, elevations of 960 to 1,900 feet and 24 to 30 inches of rain a year.
